payload.summary: Therapy catalogue: all 205 records now carry governed references; 26 await the owner's sign-off with therapy:review
payload.detail: PR #3613 added governed guideline and literature references to the remaining 26 needs_review Therapy Compass records, including wake-therapy-sleep-deprivation-chronotherapy. Its sign-offs on those 26 records were stamped without the interactive tool and were reset to needs_review by owner ruling (17 Oct 2026 22:12 AWST; docs/decisions/2026-10-17-agent-recorded-therapy-and-did-sign-offs-reset.md). Close this once the owner has signed each record with npm run therapy:review.
